title: Validate a cube slice and profile

scenes.title: Set up the XY section
scenes.caption: Use bohr coordinates, an XY plane through the origin, and a 4 by 4 bohr section with 81 by 81 samples.

scenes.title: Read the signed scale
scenes.caption: Use a fixed range from minus 0.45 to plus 0.45. The zero contour separates negative and positive values.

scenes.title: Make the plane and profile
scenes.caption: The signed contour image and plane CSV describe the same section. The profile runs along x from minus four to plus four bohr.
scenes.prompt: Make the signed XY section, export the plane PNG and CSV, and sample the x profile at 81 positions.

scenes.title: Verify the CSV boundaries
scenes.caption: The profile has 81 rows and covers 4.2334 angstroms. Both endpoints are outside the grid and have blank value cells.
scenes.prompt: Check the sample count, scalar units, and status of both endpoints before returning the files.
